name: transitionJiraIssue
description: Move a Jira issue through its workflow and/or into a sprint or the backlog — at least one is required. Take transitionId from listJiraIssueTransitions; transitionName is the transition's own name, not the target status. Returns the status the issue actually landed in, so no read-back is needed. If the sprint/backlog move fails after the status change succeeds, the status change stays — retry the move alone, not the whole call.

cloudId.description: Site UUID or Jira/Confluence URL for this operation's Atlassian site. cloudId is never silently auto-resolved or reused for you — call getAccessibleAtlassianResources ONCE per session, cache the returned cloudId, and pass it explicitly on this and every subsequent call, since most operations need it. `execute` and its read/write/destructive variants strictly require it for cloudId-scoped operations and fail without it. Not needed for cloudId-less operations (e.g. Bitbucket), which ignore this field.

transitionId.description: Transition ID (get from listJiraIssueTransitions). Provide either transitionId or transitionName.

transitionName.description: Name of the transition itself, not the target status — the two often differ, so "Done" does not match a transition named "Review->Done". Provide either transitionId or transitionName.

fields.description: Optional Jira field values to apply during the workflow transition.

update.description: Optional Jira field update operations to apply during the workflow transition. A comment passed here may be dropped without error — the transition reports success and no comment is created. Use addOrEditJiraIssueComment instead.

historyMetadata.description: Optional issue history metadata to attach to the workflow transition.

sprintId.description: Assign the issue into this sprint. Mutually exclusive with assignToBacklog.

assignToBacklog.description: Set true to assign the issue to the backlog, mutually exclusive with sprintId. Optionally use boardId to target a specific board's backlog.

boardId.description: Only used when assignToBacklog is true: targets this specific board's backlog (board IDs from listJiraBoards). Ignored otherwise.

actionSource.description: Optional invocation attribution. Jira MCP cards set jira_mcp_card; omit for model/tool-loop calls.
